description:
Chotot: One-stop marketplace for everything you need

Chotot is Vietnam's leading one-stop platform for buying and selling, designed to meet your needs at every stage of life. Whether you are looking for a new home, upgrading your vehicle, or decluttering your house, we connect you with millions of buyers and sellers nationwide to make trading simple, efficient, and reliable.

Why you will love using Chotot:

- Discover great-value items quickly: Explore a wide range of listings—from vehicles to home essentials—tailored to your budget and location.
- Shop smart for quality pre-owned goods: Find secondhand electronics, furniture, and fashion at wallet-friendly prices.
- Trade with more confidence: Review listing details and seller information to make more informed decisions.

As part of the Carousell Group, Chotot is committed to empowering Vietnamese daily life through recommerce. We strive to meet all your needs at every stage of life while promoting smart, sustainable consumption choices.
